item.title: Ask HN: Anyone else struggle with how to learn coding in the AI era?
item.description:
📝 I'm someone who got into building/programming in early 2025, when vibe coding tools became more usable. Since then, I'd like to think that I have developed a lot as a programmer, but I still have this deep sense of imposter syndrome / worry that AI is too much of a crutch and I'm not really learning. I have shipped a few projects, I always review AI-suggested code, do daily coding practice without AI, watch youtube videos, etc.
🔗 Read more: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46866165

item.title: Frog 'saunas' could help endangered species beat a deadly fungus (2024)
Ask HN: Where do all the web devs talk?
item.description:
📝 I've been using Twitter / X for a good decade now, and while I've found it's a great place to connect with native app dev communities (I'm well connected with the React Native scene), I really struggle to connect with any web devs. I have explored BlueSky a bit, but again it feels a bit like tumbleweeds (though maybe that's just my luck as a small account). Are web devs more old-school, posting on bulletin boards and forums.
